notes: Summary: ValencePeak is a mid-market SaaS that provides embedded help & context-aware in-app answers for SMB customers. Primary objective: low-latency, high-QPS knowledge-base RAG pipeline that uses embeddings for retrieval and a cross-encoder reranker for final scoring. Indexing: current corpus ~1.2M docs (mixed short articles, FAQs, and transcripts); expect up to ~3M within 12 months. QPS: typical peak 500-1,200 QPS during business hours; burst up to 2.5k for product launches. Latency targets: retrieval+rerank end-to-end <=150ms (aspirational), acceptable <=250ms; 95th percentile SLA requested. Cost sensitivity: moderate-high — wants >3x cost improvement over current managed provider at parity for latency. Model preferences: open/quantized models for cost control; bi-encoder for recall, cross-encoder (smaller fine-tuned) for rerank. Routing/fallback: prefer region-aware routing (us/eu), fallback to smaller model when capacity constrained. Security: SOC2 required pre-contract, SAML SSO, audit logs with 90-day retention, option for data residency in EU. Evaluation scope: hosted API POC with 30-day test, throughput tests at 500/1k/1.5k QPS, index refresh cadence tests (hourly deltas), cold-start and autoscale scenarios, cost per-1000-queries estimate.
